description: Narrow default capability set for the Syncra desktop shell (SYNCDESKTOP.md §6.3, docs/DESKTOP-ARCHITECTURE.md §5.3). clipboard-manager:allow-read-text stays ABSENT and no runtime grant was built for it: F5-6 reads the clipboard from RUST (src/clipboard.rs), where capabilities do not apply, so the webview still cannot read the clipboard at all — a narrower surface than granting it and gating it. The quick-capture window (F5-3) is listed under `windows` and needs core:window:allow-hide to dismiss itself.
